title: 热面包卷和两声铃响  (Warm Rolls and Two Rings)

segments.t: Five minutes later, the warm scent of fresh bread drifts out from the breakfast corner at Courtyard Inn. Morning baker Mei carries over a basket of hot rolls to meet Qing and Chen. Let's listen in first.
你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
所以老房子自己会打招呼？
没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
Now let's go back through the scene, line by line.
你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
'Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.' Mei softens her guess by ending with
吧
a friendly sentence-ender that turns a statement into 'right?'.
你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
'Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!' One vivid word,
香
covers fragrant food, aromatic tea, or fresh bread—anything that smells delicious.
刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
'Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.' Handy bakery talk:
趁热
packs 'while it is still hot' into two brisk syllables.
跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
'With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.' Mei calls stiff polite formulas
客气话
built from 'guest-air' plus 'words'—speech meant for guests, not coworkers.
小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
'Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.' Notice Mandarin word order with 'with someone': Chen says 'Mei with everyone talks', putting the partner phrase before the action.
那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
'What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!' To count quick taps or rings, Chinese uses
两下
where the second word counts brief actions like presses or knocks.
那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
'Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.' Two tiny words,
没人
say 'nobody' by literally stating 'have-not person'.
所以老房子自己会打招呼？
'So the old house says hello by itself?' Everyday phrase:
打招呼
literally means 'strike a greeting call', the natural way to say 'say hello'.
没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
'Exactly! You already fit right in here.' Mei agrees warmly with
没错
literally 'no mistake', a crisp everyday equivalent of 'spot on' or 'exactly'. Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
所以老房子自己会打招呼？
没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
Qing has a warm roll in her hand and an instant friend in the café corner. You will hear casual and polite greetings side by side in every episode. See you next time.
回头见！
